<translate>
<!--T:7-->
The '''Z armor sets''' are the 51 character-themed sets whose pattern is painted on a '''Blank Pattern (Z)'''. They only differ in looks: every set uses the Kikono armor material and gives the same protection.
</translate>

<translate>
== Crafting a set == <!--T:8-->

<!--T:9-->
# Paint the set's pattern on a Blank Pattern (Z) at the '''Pattern Station'''.
# Assemble each piece at '''Dr. Kikono's Station''' with the pattern, Kikono Cloth, Kikono String and the matching iron armor piece. Each piece costs 1,000 Star Energy.

<!--T:10-->
See [[Special:MyLanguage/Armor|Armor]] for the full process, the recipes and how armor adds to your defense.
</translate>

<translate>

<translate>
== Sets with a helmet == <!--T:23-->

<!--T:24-->
Seven sets also include a helmet: Control Jewelry Set (Broly), Crane School (Chaoz), Demon GI (Piccolo), Evil Namekian (Slug), Hero of Justice (Great Saiyaman), Hero of Justice 2 (Great Saiyaman 2) and Red Ribbon Army (Android 20).

<!--T:29-->
The '''Control Jewelry Tiara (Broly)''' completes Broly's Control Jewelry Set, which has four pieces with it. It is made like any other helmet, at Dr. Kikono's Station from the set's pattern, an Iron Helmet, 2 Kikono Cloth and 3 Kikono String. Unlike most helmets it keeps your hair visible. While you wear it, in the helmet slot or the Cosmetic Armor slot, the [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan|Saiyan]] Mutant forms take Broly's colors: Ikari gets cyan hair and a gold aura, SSJ Hybrid a gold aura and SSJ Full Power a lime aura.
</translate>
{{Recipe|broly_z_armor_helmet}}

<translate>
== Battle damage == <!--T:25-->

<!--T:26-->
Goku's Turtle Hermit GI, the Great Saiyaman outfit and Vegeta's Saiyan armor switch to a torn, battle-damaged look once they drop below half durability.
</translate>
